title: AdaptiveSFSelect step-3 density threshold: fix oracles (ccp.py, generate.py, Rust test ref) and regenerate ccp16_load_balance vector
description: Follow-up from spec reconciliation g7p7 (which fixed spec/02-physical-link.md:115 to >8 per 02a 2a.8). Three code-side transcriptions still use density > 10 in step 3: (1) python/src/lichen/ccp.py:231 + docstring :197; (2) test/vectors/generate.py:2652 _ccp15_adaptive_sf (the vector generator oracle); (3) rust/lichen-core/tests/ccp16_utilization_vectors.rs:53 reference select_tx_sf. Current vectors still PASS because distinguishing inputs are absent EXCEPT ccp16_load_balance.json synchronized_hop_high_density (density=10, snr=5, load=0, loss=0, util=0): spec-correct output is sf=12 (step-3 10+2), committed output sf=11 baked from the >10 oracle (its oracle_note says so). Plan: fix all three oracles, hand-verify against spec 02a 2a.8 (NOT from the code), regenerate/patch the vector (sf 11 -> 12 + oracle_note), then run python pytest test_vectors.py + test_ccp.py and cargo test -p lichen-core --test ccp16_utilization_vectors. Do NOT edit vector outputs before the oracles — suites would go red.
